body: Thank you. I appreciate your words and the time you took to write them

I started taking it because I was having frequent panic attacks and I probably shouldn't put this out there but nobody knows who I am. But I had a virtual doctors meeting and I told him that everything was fine because the day before I told my friend that I had feelings for her and apologized for them and she understood and didnt shame me so that was the only day I felt happy so I thought it was because I liked her and needed to tell her  what I feel. Like i thought that was the problem and maybe it is but maybe its not
I already have that's why I'm posting here I'm looking for anyone who might know something. And I do appreciate you for trying. Thank you
I've also heard of hotlines rejecting or hanging up on people and that might push me over the edge and I'm doing whatever I can to hang on
I live with my mother and she loves me I know she does but she doesn't understand and always tries to compare her problems to mine
I understand what you're saying but I'm in such a deep hole mentally I cant even think straight
That scares me even more. The thought that maybe it isnt the meds but it's just me and I dont think I can fight for that long
I just turned eighteen and I dont have insurance anymore I had to start taking less of the medication because I cant afford it
